metadataRaw.description:
Shawn came to SpineCare in St. Joseph, MI looking for foot drop treatment and relief from a lumbar pinched nerve. He was also suffering from numbness and tingling in his ankle and foot.

After a series of Spinal Decompression Therapy and chiropractic treatments, his foot drop, numbness, tingling, and gait have significantly improved. 

"It definitely seems to be helping. I would recommend him (Dr.Rowe) if you have drop foot and if you're wondering what to do about it."
